themes.name: Agentic AI in research

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries for easier comprehension and insight extraction.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discussions around AI-generated personas or data that simulate real user behavior for testing, analysis, or content creation.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the research and analysis of AI chatbots, their capabilities, limitations, and user interactions.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles about specific AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist in various stages of the research process.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being integrated into design workflows and research methodologies to enhance creativity, efficiency, and insights.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Content examining how AI is affecting jobs, skills, and the overall structure of the workforce, particularly in research and development roles.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles detailing the use of AI to automate software testing processes, improving efficiency and accuracy.

themes.name: AI survey tools
